Name: Dynamic groups using memberOf
Description: Finds dynamic membership groups whose membership rule uses the memberOf attribute (user.memberof / device.memberof), so they can be rewritten before the attribute is retired. Lists the groups each rule references. Read-only; run it once per tenant and combine the CSVs on the TenantId column.
Author: Admin Toolkit

Parameters.Name: ResolveReferencedGroups
Parameters.Label: Resolve referenced groups
Parameters.HelpText: Look up the names of the groups each memberOf rule points to, and flag ones that no longer exist

Parameters.Name: IncludeAllDynamic
Parameters.Label: Include all dynamic groups
Parameters.HelpText: Also list dynamic groups that don't use memberOf (UsesMemberOf = False)
